description: Amazon Transcribe options of the Transcription section, and why each combination cannot be used: `streaming` for a streaming meeting, `upload` for an Upload Audio recording (a batch job), null when it can be used. Read by lma_config's tests (lma-ai-stack/source/lambda_layers/configuration_layer/lma_config/test_transcribe_options.py) and by the tests of transcribeOptionsProblem in the WebSocket transcriber (lma-websocket-transcriber-stack/source/app/src/config/transcribe-options.test.ts), so uploads refuse the same combinations streaming meetings do. An upload does not check the preferred language (batch jobs have none) and needs at least two language options to identify the language.
